sloka: ततः शत्रुघ्न भरतौ कौसल्याम् प्रेक्ष्य दुह्खितौ ।पर्यष्वजेताम् दुह्ख आर्ताम् पतिताम् नष्ट चेतनाम् ॥२-७५-९॥
transliteration: tataḥ śatrughna bharatau kausalyām prekṣya duhkhitau ।paryaṣvajetām duhkha ārtām patitām naṣṭa cetanām ॥2-75-9॥

translations.english: Then agonised Bharata and Satrughna, beholding that venerable, noblehearted, griefstricken, weeping Kausalya who was almost semiconscious overcome with grief, approached her with great sorrow and hugged her.
